name: Battle

components.pose: She leaps mid-air with her windsong staff swept behind her and her free hand flung forward, scarves streaming, a joyful, fierce gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.headwear: a slim {{METAL}} circlet with feather wings
components.jewelry: a silver feather gorget, bracers hung with tiny bells
components.legs_feet: light jade greaves over soft boots
components.effects: A roaring gale spirals out from her hand tearing banners and debris sideways, silk scarves streaming, ribbons of {{MAGIC}} wind marking the currents.

notes: BATTLE: the sister in class-aligned war gear commanding her element on a battlefield of her homeland. Reuses her signature weapon.
